label: Diagram 3.3
caption: Diagram 3.3 Flat with restricted travel distance from furthest point to entrance
description:
Two floor plans of flats, each with the 'Flat entrance' in the bottom wall, showing travel distances from the furthest points to the entrance (see para 3.18).

In the left-hand plan, two green lines marked '9m max.' run from the flat entrance: one to the far corner of the 'Kitchen area' by the sink (top left), the other to the top right-hand corner of the room on the right. A grey line runs from the entrance into the 'Bath' at the top, labelled 'Distance not restricted'.

In the right-hand plan, the entrance opens into a hall. One green route, '9m max.', runs from the far corner of the 'Kitchen' (top left) through the kitchen door and down the hall to the entrance; another, also '9m max.', runs from the top right-hand corner of the room on the right to the entrance.
model_description:
The drawing consists of two plan views, labelled a. and b., showing the internal layout of a flat and the travel distances from various points to the flat entrance.

In part a., a rectangular flat is shown containing a kitchen area and a bathroom (labelled 'Bath'). A 'Flat entrance' is located at the bottom of the plan. Two green lines originate from the entrance and extend into the flat. One line extends from the entrance to the corner of the kitchen area, labelled '9m max'. The second line extends from the entrance towards the bathroom, also labelled '9m max'. A third green line extends from the entrance towards the far wall of the bathroom, but it is labelled 'Distance not restricted'. A note at the top left says 'See para 3.18'.

In part b., a second, simpler rectangular flat layout is shown. A 'Flat entrance' is at the bottom. Two green lines extend from the entrance into the flat: one reaches the corner of the kitchen, labelled '9m max', and the other reaches the opposite corner of the flat, also labelled '9m max'.
